definitions.explanation: Previously worn clothing that is sold or given away.

examples.japanese: ⟦フリーマーケット→フリーマーケット：09804_furiimaaketto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{古着|ふるぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{売|う}る→売る：00906_uru⟧。
examples.english: To sell used clothes at a flea market.

examples.japanese: {古着|ふるぎ}⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{掘|ほ}り{出|だ}し{物|もの}→掘り出し物：14746_horidashimono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つけた→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I found a bargain at the secondhand clothing store.

notes:
{古着|ふるぎ} refers to secondhand or used clothing. It is neutral in tone — it does not imply the clothing is worn out or low quality.

FORMS:
{古|ふる} (old, used) + {着|ぎ} (clothing, from ⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧ "to wear"). Note the rendaku: {着|き} becomes {着|ぎ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {古着|ふるぎ}⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧: secondhand clothing store
- {古着|ふるぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to buy used clothes
- {古着|ふるぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{売|う}る→売る：00906_uru⟧: to sell used clothes

CULTURAL NOTE:
{古着|ふるぎ} shopping is popular in Japan, especially among younger people. Famous areas include {下北沢|しもきたざわ} in ⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧ and {堀江|ほりえ} in ⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧. The term covers both affordable thrift items and curated vintage fashion.

SIMILAR:
- ⟦{中古|ちゅうこ}→中古：03479_chuuko⟧: secondhand (for goods in general, not clothing-specific)
- ⟦{古本|ふるほん}→古本：14745_furuhon⟧: used books (same ⟦{古|ふる}→古〜：03966_furu⟧～ pattern)
